unhaus/ovipostor.about-caput: What can you tell me about Caput?
unhaus/ovipostor.about-murder: Why did you kill that mare?
unhaus/ovipostor.about-queen: What can you tell me about your queen?
unhaus/ovipostor.encounter/entry: You ponies really can’t make my life easy. Listen, how about you waddle away, forget anything happened, and we both can be happy.
unhaus/ovipostor.encounter/hostile-answer: No way I let a monster like you walk around.
unhaus/ovipostor.encounter/on-intimidate: So-so sorry for standing in your way. You won’t see me ever again.
unhaus/ovipostor.encounters/intimidate-answer: Give the bug-pony a threatening death stare.
unhaus/ovipostor.hive/entry: A pony in the hive? This place is supposed to be secret. The queen can’t just let every collaborator walk in.
unhaus/ovipostor.hive/intro-intimidated: Shit! I almost jumped out of my carapace! What are you doing here? I guess it makes sense the queen hires machines like you.
unhaus/ovipostor.hive/intro-met: You again?! Are you supposed to be here? I guess the queen does occasionally employ ponies… so what do you want?
unhaus/ovipostor.hive/introduction: A pony in the hive? This place is supposed to be secret. The queen can’t just let every collaborator walk in.
unhaus/ovipostor.hive/on-caput: Her? More or less she’s the local jester. Harmless if a bit stupid. She’s not really allowed out because she doesn’t understand why we hide.
unhaus/ovipostor.hive/on-murder: She was the interest of some raider boss. Queeny wanted him gone. I took her appearance to kill. You should thank me, pony, for cleaning up the trash.
unhaus/ovipostor.hive/on-queen:
Trying to get secrets out of me are you?

He suspiciously looks you up and down.

I won’t tell you more than that I think she is doing a good job, though she’s a bit cranky.
unhaus/ovipostor.hive/on-self:
He sighs.
Somehow telling it to a pony makes it worse. I’m ovipositor. I’ll have you know that is an acceptable changeling name.
unhaus/ovipostor.scene-line: Nothing personal, there just can't be two of you around.
